name: P2Y receptor family member 8
pathways: Rho-activating G protein-coupled receptor signaling pathway

function.text: P2RY8 encodes s-geranylgeranyl-glutathione receptor P2RY8. Annotated molecular activities include G protein-coupled receptor activity and G protein-coupled purinergic nucleotide receptor activity. It participates in G protein-coupled receptor signaling pathway and Rho-activating G protein-coupled receptor signaling pathway.
